deep_q_network.summary: A neural network learns the value of going short, flat or long from each bar's features by walking the training span, replaying past steps and learning against a frozen copy of itself.
deep_q_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the long share of a softmax over Q(long) and Q(short), temperature fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent and its position is not in the state, so this is cost-aware reward maximisation on the train span's price tape (next-open fills, round-trip cost). Expect: an edge only where the features predict the h-bar move.

layer_count.description: How many hidden layers the shared encoder has.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: How big a step each gradient update takes (Adam).

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.description: How many replayed transitions one gradient update averages over.

epochs.label: Episodes
epochs.description: How many times the agent walks the whole training span bar by bar (one episode each).

patience.label: Patience
patience.description: Stop after this many episodes without a better validation net reward.

discount_factor.label: Discount factor
discount_factor.description: How much the value of the next bar counts in today's value. The next bar does not depend on the action here, so this changes the scale of the values, not the choice.

replay_capacity.label: Replay capacity
replay_capacity.description: How many past transitions the replay buffer keeps; the oldest are overwritten.

target_update_interval.label: Target update interval
target_update_interval.description: How many gradient updates pass before the frozen target network is refreshed with the online network's weights.

environment_steps_per_update.label: Bars per update
environment_steps_per_update.description: How many bars the agent walks between two gradient updates.

gradient_norm_limit.label: Gradient norm limit
gradient_norm_limit.description: Gradients are rescaled so their norm never exceeds this.

exploration_start.label: Exploration at the start
exploration_start.description: The chance of a random action at the first bar (epsilon-greedy).

exploration_end.label: Exploration at the end
exploration_end.description: The chance of a random action once the decay is over.

exploration_decay_fraction.label: Exploration decay share
exploration_decay_fraction.description: The share of all training bars over which the random-action chance falls linearly from its start to its end value.

double_deep_q_network.summary: DQN whose target lets the online network pick the next action and the frozen network value it, which removes the upward bias of taking a maximum over noisy estimates.
double_deep_q_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the long share of a softmax over Q(long) and Q(short), temperature fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent and its position is not in the state, so this is cost-aware reward maximisation on the train span's price tape (next-open fills, round-trip cost). The online net picks the next action, the target net values it. Expect: less inflated values than DQN; much the same calls.

dueling_deep_q_network.summary: A Q-network split into a state-value stream and an action-advantage stream, recombined with the mean advantage subtracted, trained with the Double DQN target.
dueling_deep_q_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the long share of a softmax over Q(long) and Q(short), temperature fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent and its position is not in the state, so this is cost-aware reward maximisation on the train span's price tape (next-open fills, round-trip cost). Uses the Double DQN target (the spec's practical default). Expect: calls close to Double DQN.

noisy_deep_q_network.summary: DQN that explores through learned noise in the weights of its Q-head instead of random actions; training shrinks the noise where the agent is sure.
noisy_deep_q_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the long share of a softmax over Q(long) and Q(short), temperature fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent and its position is not in the state, so this is cost-aware reward maximisation on the train span's price tape (next-open fills, round-trip cost). Learned head noise explores; it is off at prediction. Expect: calls like DQN once the noise shrinks.

rainbow_deep_q_network.summary: Six DQN improvements together: the Double target, dueling streams, noisy layers, multi-step returns, prioritized replay and a distribution over returns instead of one expected value.
rainbow_deep_q_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the long share of a softmax over Q(long) and Q(short), temperature fitted on validation. Differs from the spec: the market ignores the agent and its position is not in the state, so this is cost-aware reward maximisation on the train span's price tape (next-open fills, round-trip cost). C51 atoms span the scaled reward; P(up) reads their means. Expect: the slowest of the five.
